description: Native clipboard history manager with a tray popover, search, pinning, and automatic paste

script: if ($sourceDirs.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Could not identify the Cliptray source directory in the downloaded archive.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vswhere)) { throw 'Cliptray needs Visual Studio Build Tools with the Desktop development with C++ workload and Windows SDK. Install those components, then retry.' }
if (-not $vsPath) { throw 'Cliptray needs the MSVC x64/x86 C++ build tools. Install the Visual Studio Build Tools C++ workload, then retry.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $vsDevCmd)) { throw 'Visual Studio VsDevCmd.bat was not found; the Cliptray MSVC build environment is incomplete.' }

@('@echo off', ('call "' + $vsDevCmd + '" -arch=x64 -host_arch=x64'), 'if errorlevel 1 exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%', ('cd /d "' + $sourceRoot + '"'), 'if errorlevel 1 exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%', 'call npm.cmd ci --no-audit --no-fund', 'if errorlevel 1 exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%', 'call node_modules\.bin\tauri.cmd build --no-bundle', 'exit /b %ERRORLEVEL%') | Set-Content -LiteralPath $buildCmd -Encoding ASCII
if ($buildExit -ne 0) { throw "Cliptray source build failed with exit code $buildExit." }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $appExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Cliptray build completed without the expected executable: $appExe" }

post_install: if ($sourceDirs.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Cliptray executable was not found after the source build.' }
pre_uninstall: if ($running) { throw 'Close Cliptray before updating or uninstalling it through Scoop.' }
notes: This manifest builds the exact linked GitHub repository from a pinned commit; the repository does not publish a Windows release asset.

Build prerequisites: nodejs-lts, rust-msvc, and Visual Studio Build Tools with MSVC x64/x86 C++ tools and a Windows SDK. WebView2 Runtime is also required on systems where it is not already installed.

The upstream repository currently has no declared license or LICENSE file, so the manifest uses Unknown. Review status remains until a Windows build and launch are tested and the upstream license is clarified.
The upstream project does not publish a checksum for source archives; the manifest pins the archive to a full commit SHA instead.
